scope: Search for new Estonian name-history sources; EE histories from Estonian spellings listed inside Rajandi (1966) main-list headwords.
method: Open EE names were matched against the headword part (before the dash or arrow) of every Rajandi main-list entry, with OCR letter-spacing undone (workspace-root var/namedays-research/raj135.mjs). 17 hits; each entry was cropped from the page image and read. Reeda (not a headword) and Võitur (only a cross-reference to Vottele) were skipped. The histories restate the entry: origin, Estonian forms and, where given, use in Estonia.

failed_leads.EE-SIN2008-45: User-supplied PDF “admin,+sin_2008_45-58.pdf”: P. Mikkonen on the Finnish naming law (Sprog i Norden 2008). No Estonian name histories.
failed_leads.DIGAR collection 20483: Mats Tõnisson’s 1884 prayer book “Siioni teekäija Palwe raamat”, not the name calendar.
failed_leads.EE-HERGAUK-MALD: Article fetched; no name histories for open names.
failed_leads.EE-OK-2016-2-16: Oma Keel 2016/2 article; no name histories for open names.
failed_leads.EE-ESA64-2018-205: Emakeele Seltsi aastaraamat 64 article; no name histories for open names.
failed_leads.EE-PUSS-KK: Keel ja Kirjandus article; no name histories for open names.
